summary.content:
Today's selection covers 95 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 65 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: The messy politics behind Google’s big AI shakeup
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: AI Sends Global Crime Syndicates Into Fraud Nirvana
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, NY Times Tech, SecurityWeek, Dark Reading, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 53 articles published in the last 24 hours
